title: Paul McCartney calls Mal Evans | 1975
content:
Paul McCartney telephoned Mal Evans on 14 December 1975.

The pair had met several days earlier, when McCartney was visiting Los Angeles. Evans had expressed concern over his finances, and asked McCartney if he was due any payments from Apple for past work, including contributions to songs including ‘Fixing A Hole’.

During the phone conversation, McCartney invited Evans to work on Wings’ 1976 tour of the US, one leg of the Wings Over The World Tour.

I do feel our friendship is as strong as ever. I certainly admire everything he’s done since and will staunchly defend him to the death.

Paul and Linda have come in for a lot of criticism from so-called friends, but in spite of the hurt this must have caused, he carried on to follow his own star – a man to be admired and respected in the profession he has chosen.

Mal Evans
Living The Beatles Legend
